title: Built Heritage Committee - November 12, 2024
meeting_location: Champlain Room, 110 Laurier Avenue West, and by electronic participation

agenda_items.title: Notices and meeting information for meeting participants and the public

attachments.attachment_title: Public Notices English - Hybrid Standing Committee.pdf
Public Notices French - Hybrid Standing Committee.pdf

agenda_items.description:
Notices and meeting information are attached to the agenda and minutes, including: availability of simultaneous interpretation and accessibility accommodations; in camera meeting procedures; information items not subject to discussion; personal information disclaimer for correspondents and public speakers; notices regarding minutes; and hybrid participation details.
Accessible formats and communication supports are available, upon request.
Except where otherwise indicated, reports requiring Council consideration will be presented to Council on November 27 in Built Heritage Committee Report 19.
The deadline to register by phone to speak, or submit written comments or visual presentations is 4 pm on November 8, and the deadline to register by email to speak is 8:30 am on November 12.

sub_agendas_items.title: Designation of 1121 Wellington Street West under Part IV of the Ontario Heritage Act

attachments.attachment_title: 5.3 ACS2024-PDB-RHU-0071 - Designation of 1121 Wellington Street West.pdf

motions.motion_text:
Report Recommendation(s)
That the Built Heritage Committee recommend that Council issue a Notice of Intention to Designate the Tollkeeper’s House, 1121 Wellington Street West under Part IV of theOntario Heritage Actaccording to the Statement of Cultural Heritage Value attached as Document 4.

WHEREAS the report for this item titled “Designation of 1121 Wellington Street West under Part IV ofOntario Heritage Act” was published on November 6, 2024, after the publication of the agenda on October 31, 2024;
BE IT RESOLVED THAT the Built Heritage Committee approve the addition of the report for consideration at today’s meeting, pursuant to subsection 89(3) of the Procedure By-law (being by-law no. 2022-410).

WHEREAS the property owner has requested additional time to discuss the proposed designation with staff in order to understand the process and potential implications of designation
THEREFORE BE IT RESOLVED that Built Heritage committee approve the following:
